$comment: Human sign-off for criteria in docs/criteria.json marked kind='manual'.
These cannot be machine-verified, so the gate refuses to pass them on reaching their
milestone until a person has looked and recorded the result here. An empty list is the
honest state until someone actually checks.
Add an entry only after genuinely performing the check:
"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "notes": "what you looked at and what you saw" }
A sign-off is scoped to the milestone it was given at. If the UI changes materially
after sign-off, delete the entry - a stale tick is worse than no tick.

signoffs.notes: Reviewed the rendered report (sample-run-01 and capture-run-02) in the browser, both themes. Status is carried by a glyph plus a visually-hidden status word on every step row, and by a text pill on every scenario row, so it never depends on colour alone. Approved.

Approved in both themes. Backed by measurement rather than judgement alone: every foreground/background pair in the palette was computed against both --surface and --surface-2. Dark theme was already AA throughout; light theme had four status colours below 4.5:1 (passed 3.96, skipped 3.14, pending 3.81, undefined 4.23) and those were darkened to 5.6-6.5:1 before this sign-off was given. Ratios are recorded beside the values in report.css.

Hook rows render italic, dimmed and without a keyword column, so they read as quieter than Gherkin steps - while a FAILED hook returns to full opacity and normal style, so the most common CI failure (a throwing BeforeScenario) is not lost. Checked against Hooks.feature in the rendered report. Approved.
